name: ObstacleMode
doc: How the navigation reacts to a dynamic obstacle.

variants.name: carve
variants.doc: Cut the box out of the navmesh (background tile rebake). Paths go around.

variants.name: area
variants.doc: Relabel the box with area, whose per-type cost decides avoidance.

variants.name: avoid
variants.doc: No rebake: local avoidance only (moving carts, temporary crowds).
